BiblicalUsage: Chaluqqah is a distribution, a division — and it appears once, when Josiah kept the Passover and the Levites stood in the holy place according to the divisions of the families.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe order is worship too: every family in its division, every Levite in his place, and the Passover kept as it was written.
